help e2631rescue
e2631rescue - serve the web failsafe (v1+v2) on lan1

Usage:
e2631rescue e2631rescue - start DHCP and the HTTP failsafe page. GET /, /status,
              /slots, /env, /backup; POST /flash, /firmware, /boot,
              /factory, /env, /console.  No flash is written until a
              validated image is uploaded with the X-E2631-Confirm
              header.  Ctrl-C leaves the rescue mode.
